y-m-30-05.title: Shin rhombus koyaushe yana shiga cikin da’ira?
y-m-30-05.topic: Jimillar kusurwoyin da ke gaba da juna na siffa mai gefuna huɗu da aka rubuta cikin da’ira
y-m-30-05.goal: Yi amfani da gaskiyar cewa jimillar kusurwoyi biyu masu gaba da juna na siffa mai gefuna huɗu da aka rubuta cikin da’ira ita ce 180° a matsayin mizani don bincika imanin cewa “rhombus koyaushe yana shiga cikin da’ira”, sannan ka ƙirƙiri jerin kusurwoyi huɗu da dama na siffofi masu gefuna huɗu da suka cika sharuɗɗan.
y-m-30-05.material: Siffa mai gefuna huɗu wadda kololuwoyinta huɗu suke kan da’ira guda ana kiranta “siffa mai gefuna huɗu da aka rubuta cikin da’ira”. A cikinta, jimillar ma’aunin kusurwoyi biyu masu gaba da juna ita ce 180°. Jiho yana tunani cewa, “Rhombus, wanda dukkan gefunansa huɗu daidai suke, koyaushe ana iya rubuta shi cikin da’ira.” (A rhombus, kusurwoyin gaba da juna suna da ma’auni iri ɗaya.)
y-m-30-05.thinking.0: Amfani da sifa a matsayin mizani na hukunci
y-m-30-05.thinking.1: Ƙirƙirar misalai da dama da suka cika ƙuntatawa (jimillar kusurwoyi masu gaba da juna, ba parallelogram ba)
y-m-30-05.thinking.2: Nemo yanayi na musamman da zancen yake aiki a ciki
y-m-30-05.prereq.1: A rhombus, kusurwoyin gaba da juna suna da ma’auni iri ɗaya.
y-m-30-05.prereq.2: Sifa ce cewa jimillar kusurwoyi biyu masu gaba da juna na siffa mai gefuna huɗu da aka rubuta cikin da’ira ita ce 180° (a ɗauka za a iya amfani da ita a wannan aikin).
y-m-30-05.s.s1.prompt: Akwai rhombus ABCD mai ∠A = 70°. Shin ana iya rubuta wannan rhombus cikin da’ira?
y-m-30-05.s.s1.hint.0: Da farko rubuta dangantakar da dole kusurwoyi masu gaba da juna su kasance da ita idan an rubuta siffa mai gefuna huɗu cikin da’ira.
y-m-30-05.s.s1.hint.1: Nemo ma’aunin kusurwar da take gaban ∠A a wannan rhombus, sannan ka duba ko dangantakar da ke sama ta cika.
y-m-30-05.s.s1.o.a: An rubuta shi cikin da’ira. Gefuna huɗu daidai suke, saboda haka kololuwoyin huɗu suna kan da’ira.
y-m-30-05.s.s1.r.a: Yi tunani ko daidaituwar tsawon gefuna da kasancewar kololuwa a kan da’ira guda abu ɗaya ne.
y-m-30-05.s.s1.o.b: Ba a rubuta shi cikin da’ira ba. Jimillar ∠A da kusurwarsa ta gaba ∠C ita ce 140°.
y-m-30-05.s.s1.r.b: Wannan hukunci ne da ya bincika ko jimillar kusurwoyi biyu masu gaba da juna ita ce 180°.
y-m-30-05.s.s1.o.c: An rubuta shi cikin da’ira, domin jimillar kusurwoyi huɗun ita ce 360°.
y-m-30-05.s.s1.r.c: Jimillar kusurwoyi huɗu ita ce 360° a kowace siffa mai gefuna huɗu. Ka yi tunani ko wannan mizani zai iya tantance ko an rubuta ta cikin da’ira.
y-m-30-05.s.s1.o.d: Ba za ka iya yanke hukunci ba sai ka san ∠B.
y-m-30-05.s.s1.r.d: Yi tunani ko za ka iya yanke hukunci ko da ka san guda ɗaya daga ma’auratan kusurwoyi masu gaba da juna bai kai 180° ba.
y-m-30-05.s.s1.explain: A rhombus, ∠C = ∠A = 70°, don haka ∠A + ∠C = 140° ≠ 180°. Da an rubuta shi cikin da’ira, jimillar kusurwoyi biyun da ke gaba da juna dole ta zama 180°, amma ba haka ba ne. Saboda haka ba a rubuta wannan rhombus cikin da’ira ba.
y-m-30-05.s.s2.prompt: Ƙirƙiri jerin ma’aunin kusurwoyi huɗu daban-daban guda 3 (digiri, lambobi cikakku) na siffa ABCD da aka rubuta cikin da’ira wadda ba parallelogram ba ce. Kusurwoyin gaba da juna su ne A da C, da B da D. (Misalan da tsarinsu kawai ya bambanta ana ƙirga su iri ɗaya.)
y-m-30-05.s.s2.hint.0: Da farko yanke shawarar ∠A, sannan ∠C. Shin akwai dangantaka tsakanin kusurwoyi masu gaba da juna?
y-m-30-05.s.s2.hint.1: Yanke shawarar ∠B da ∠D haka nan, sannan ka duba jimillar kusurwoyi huɗu da ko ∠A da ∠C ba su daidaita ba.

y-m-30-05.s.s2.fail.c3: Jimillar kusurwoyi masu gaba da juna (A da C, B da D) ba 180° ba ce.
y-m-30-05.s.s2.ok.c4: Kusurwoyi masu gaba da juna ba su daidai da juna, saboda haka ba parallelogram ba ne.
y-m-30-05.s.s2.fail.c4: Idan ∠A da ∠C sun yi daidai, yana iya zama parallelogram. Ka sa su bambanta.

y-m-30-05.s.s3.prompt: Idan akwai rhombus da tunanin Jiho “rhombus koyaushe ana rubuta shi cikin da’ira” yake daidai a kansa, wane irin rhombus ne? Ka rubuta dalili ma.
y-m-30-05.s.s3.hint.0: A ce kusurwa ɗaya ta rhombus ita ce x, rubuta kusurwar da ke gabanta a matsayin x, sannan ka bayyana ƙimar da jimillar kusurwoyin biyun dole ta zama.
y-m-30-05.s.s3.hint.1: Bayyana da kalmomi siffar rhombus ɗin da ke da wannan x.

y-m-30-05.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ka faɗi yadda aka kayyade x (2x = 180°)?
y-m-30-05.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Ka bayyana a sarari ƙarshen cewa ba kowane rhombus ba ne?
y-m-30-05.s.s3.model.0: Murabba’i. Idan kusurwa ɗaya 90° ce, jimillar kusurwoyi masu gaba da juna 90°+90°=180° ce, saboda haka ana iya rubuta shi cikin da’ira.
y-m-30-05.s.s3.model.1: Rhombus mai kusurwoyi dama duka ne kawai, wato murabba’i, zai yiwu. Kusurwoyi masu gaba da juna na rhombus sun yi daidai, don haka idan ɗaya x ce, to 2x=180°, wato x=90°.

y-m-30-04.title: Shin kusurwar da ke ganin diamita AB koyaushe yana 90° a duk inda maki C yake?
y-m-30-04.topic: Kwancen da aka rubuta akan diamita da matsayi na aya
y-m-30-04.goal: Koyi cewa 'kusurwar da aka rubuta akan semicircle shine 90°' dukiya ce don lokacin da batu C ke kan da'irar, kuma yi amfani da misalan da kuka yi da kanku don bincika kuma faɗi abin da ke canzawa lokacin da aya a ciki ko wajen da'irar ta ga kwana ɗaya.
y-m-30-04.material: A kan jirgin sama mai daidaitawa, tsakiyar da'irar O shine asalin kuma ƙarshen ƙarshen ƙarshen AB sune A (-5, 0) da B (5, 0). Radius na da'irar shine 5, kuma maki C yana a wurin da y-coordinate ya fi 0. Hyejin ya yi amfani da gaskiyar cewa 'kusurwar da aka rubuta akan semicircle shine 90 °' don cewa, '∠ACB shine 90 ° duk inda maki C yake.' (An karanta ∠ACB a matsayin 'kwana A C B'.)

y-m-30-04.thinking.2: Ƙaddamar da sakamakon zuwa harka a wajen da'irar

y-m-30-04.s.s1.o.a: Tana da gaskiya. Idan akwai diamita AB, ∠ACB shine 90 ° duk inda C yake

y-m-30-04.s.s1.o.d: Tana da gaskiya. Amma kawai lokacin da tsayin AC da BC sun yi daidai

y-m-30-04.s.s2.prompt: Zaɓi maki C (x, y) a cikin da'irar wanda x-coordinate da y-coordinate duka lamba ne, kuma a yi misalai 3 daban-daban waɗanda ∠ACB ya fi kusurwar dama (obtuse). y-m-30-02.title: Ƙididdiga tsayin sandar tuta daga kusurwar tsayin 35°
y-m-30-02.topic: Amfani da ma'aunin trigonometric (neman tsayi daga kusurwar haɓaka)
y-m-30-02.goal: Koyi cewa kusurwar ɗagawa kaɗai ba ta ƙayyade tsayi ba, zaɓi ƙarin bayani da ake buƙata, duba cewa dole ne a ƙara tsayin ido, kuma ku yi hasashen tasirin kuskuren auna kusurwar yana da sakamako.
y-m-30-02.material: Kuna son nemo tsayin tuta a filin wasan makaranta. Kasan lebur ne kuma sandar tuta tana kan ƙasa. Tsaye a wani wuri nesa da sandar tuta kana kallon sama, ka auna kusurwar kallon sama (kusurwar tsayi) kuma yana 35°. Ba ku auna wasu ƙima ba tukuna. Reference: tan 35° shine kusan 0.7002, zunubi 35° shine kusan 0.5736, kuma cos 35° shine kusan 0.8192. Ana karanta 'tan' azaman 'tangent'.
y-m-30-02.thinking.1: Neman haɗakar bayanai daban-daban waɗanda ke haifar da sakamako iri ɗaya
y-m-30-02.thinking.2: Ƙimar tasirin kuskuren auna akan sakamakon
y-m-30-02.prereq.0: Ma'anar ma'aunin trigonometric (sine, cosine, tangent) na kwana a cikin madaidaicin alwatika
y-m-30-02.prereq.1: Karatun tebur na ƙimar ma'auni na trigonometric ko amfani da ƙimar ƙimayar da aka bayar
y-m-30-02.s.s1.prompt: Kun gano kawai kusurwar hawan 35°. Me kuke buƙatar sani don sanin tsayin sandar tuta? Zabi duk abin da ya zama dole. (Za a iya samun nau'ikan dacewa daban-daban.)
y-m-30-02.s.s1.hint.0: Kwatanta cikin kalmomi madaidaicin triangle wanda kusurwar ɗagawa yayi. Daga wane lokaci zuwa wane bangare kowanne bangare yake?
y-m-30-02.s.s1.hint.1: Daga cikin bangarorin wannan triangle, ware wadanda ka riga ka sani da wadanda ba ka sani ba, sannan ka duba ko tsayin ya fara ne daga kasa ko kuma daga idanu.
y-m-30-02.s.s1.o.a: Nisan kwance mai nisan mita 20 daga inda kuka tsaya zuwa kasan sandar tuta
y-m-30-02.s.s1.r.a: Tare da nisa a kwance, tare da kusurwar haɓaka, za ku iya ƙayyade tsayin da aka tashi daga idanu zuwa sama.
y-m-30-02.s.s1.o.b: Matsakaicin nisa daga idanu zuwa sama, kusan 24.4 m
y-m-30-02.s.s1.r.b: Nisan layin madaidaiciya, haɗe tare da kusurwar haɓaka, kuma yana ba ku damar tantance tsayi. Duk da haka, yana da wuya a auna kai tsaye.
y-m-30-02.s.s1.o.c: Tsayi daga ƙasa zuwa idanu, 1.5 m
y-m-30-02.s.s1.r.c: Idan ka sami tsayin tsayin ido kawai, ba tsayin daga ƙasa zuwa sama ba ne. Ka yi tunani daga ina zuwa inda tsayin yake.
y-m-30-02.s.s1.o.d: Kauri daga sandar tuta, kusan 10 cm
y-m-30-02.s.s1.r.d: Kauri shine bayanin da ba shi da alaƙa da tsayin saman. Yi tunanin ko tsayi ne wanda ke shiga triangle wanda ke ƙayyade tsayi.
y-m-30-02.s.s1.explain: Don nemo tsayin da ke sama da idanu daga kusurwar haɓaka, kuna buƙatar ƙarin tsayi ɗaya (tazarar kwance ko nisa madaidaiciya). Har ila yau, wannan tsayin yana daga idanu zuwa sama, don haka don nemo tsayi daga ƙasa zuwa sama, dole ne a ƙara tsayin ido.
y-m-30-02.s.s1.acc.0: Ko da kun san nisa madaidaiciya daga idanu zuwa sama, tare da kusurwar tsayi za ku iya ƙayyade tsayin da ke sama da idanu, sannan ku ƙara tsayin ido. Duk da haka, yana da wuya a auna nisa madaidaiciya kai tsaye, don haka yin amfani da nisa a kwance ya fi dacewa.
y-m-30-02.s.s2.prompt: Yanzu kun auna nisan kwance 20 m da tsayin ido 1.5 m. Menene mafi dacewa darajar tsayin sandar tuta? (tan 35°≈ 0.7002)
y-m-30-02.s.s2.hint.0: A cikin madaidaicin alwatika wanda ke da kusurwar haɓaka a matsayin kusurwa ɗaya, yanke shawarar ko 20 m da tsayin da kake son samu sune gefen da ke kusa da wannan kusurwa da gefen da ke gaba da shi.

y-m-30-02.s.s2.r.a: Wataƙila kun yi amfani da rabon trigonometric daban-daban, tare da nisa a kwance azaman gefen kusa, don nemo tsayi sama da idanu. A sake duba ko wane gefe zuwa wane gefen rabon yake.

y-m-30-02.s.s2.r.c: Wannan bayani ne wanda ya samo tsayi daga rabon nisan da ke kwance da tsayin da ke sama da idanu sannan ya kara tsayin ido.
y-m-30-02.s.s2.r.d: Wataƙila kun yi amfani da ma'aunin trigonometric wanda bai dace da alakar tsakanin tazarar kwance da tsayi ba. A sake duba abin da sanannen gefe da gefen da kake son nemo kowannensu.
y-m-30-02.s.s2.explain: Tsayin da ke sama da idanu shine 20 × tan 35 ° ≈ 20 × 0.7002 ≈ 14.0 m, kuma ƙara tsayin ido 1.5 m yana ba da kusan 15.5 m.

y-m-30-06.title: Shin an kayyade fadin alwatika mai gefuna biyu 6 da 10?
y-m-30-06.topic: Fadin alwatika (gefe biyu da kusurwar da ke tsakaninsu)
y-m-30-06.goal: Koyi cewa tsawon gefuna biyu kaɗai ba ya kayyade fadin alwatika, bambance ƙarin bayanin da zai kayyade shi, sannan ka bayyana cewa akwai alwatika masu fadi iri ɗaya amma siffofi mabambanta.
y-m-30-06.material: A cikin alwatika ABC, abin da ka sani kawai shi ne AB = 6 cm da AC = 10 cm, ba ka san ma’aunin ∠A ba tukuna. Tunda alwatika ce, 0° < ∠A < 180°. Ana iya nemo fadi da ½ × AB × AC × sin A (ana karanta “sin A” sine A). Ƙimomin tunani: sin 30° = 1/2, sin 60° = (√3)/2 ≈ 0.866, sin 90° = 1, sin 150° = 1/2. Sine na kusurwa mai faɗi yana daidai da sine na kusurwa mai kaifi da aka samu ta cire wannan kusurwa daga 180° (misali, sin 150° = sin 30°).
y-m-30-06.thinking.1: Nemo duk amsoshin da suka cika sharaɗi ɗaya
y-m-30-06.thinking.2: Bayyana cewa siffofi sun bambanta duk da fadi iri ɗaya
y-m-30-06.prereq.0: Furucin fadin alwatika ta amfani da gefuna biyu da sine na kusurwar da ke tsakaninsu (½ × samfurin gefuna biyu × sin(kusurwar da ke tsakaninsu))
y-m-30-06.prereq.1: Ƙimomi kamar sin 30°, sin 90°, sin 150° (an bayar a rubutu cewa sine na kusurwa mai faɗi daidai yake da sine na kusurwa mai kaifi da aka samu ta cire ta daga 180°)
y-m-30-06.prereq.2: Ka’idojin daidaituwar alwatika (idan an kayyade gefuna ukun, an kayyade alwatika guda ɗaya)
y-m-30-06.s.s1.prompt: Bayan AB = 6 da AC = 10, zaɓi duk yanayin da fadin alwatika zai zama ƙima guda ɗaya idan an san ɗaya daga cikin bayanan da ke biye.
y-m-30-06.s.s1.hint.0: Ga kowane bayani, tantance dabam ko alwatika guda ɗaya kawai za a iya ƙirƙira ko kuwa da dama.
y-m-30-06.s.s1.hint.1: Ga “kusurwa mai kaifi ce”, nemo aƙalla ƙimomi biyu masu yiwuwa na ∠A, sannan ka kwatanta fadi.
y-m-30-06.s.s1.r.a: Yi tunani ko ƙimar sin A tana canzawa ta hanyoyi da dama a cikin yankin kusurwoyi masu kaifi.
y-m-30-06.s.s1.r.b: Yi tunani ko an kayyade alwatika guda ɗaya idan an kayyade gefuna ukun duka.
y-m-30-06.s.s1.r.c: Yi tunani ko idan an san kusurwar da ke tsakanin gefunan, za ka iya nemo fadi kai tsaye ta amfani da fomula.
y-m-30-06.s.s1.o.d: Alwatikan ba alwatika mai gefuna biyu daidai ba ne.
y-m-30-06.s.s1.r.d: Yi tunani ko wannan bayani yana kayyade ∠A a matsayin ƙima guda ɗaya.
y-m-30-06.s.s1.explain: Idan an san kusurwar da ke tsakanin gefuna ∠A = 60°, fadin an kayyade shi da ½×6×10×sin 60° = 15√3 ≈ 26.0 cm². Idan BC=8 ne, an kayyade tsawon gefuna ukun, don haka alwatika guda ɗaya ne (a zahiri 6, 8, 10 alwatika ce mai kusurwar dama a B, don haka fadi ½×6×8 = 24 cm² ne), kuma fadin ma ƙima guda ɗaya ce. “Kusurwa mai kaifi ce” ko “ba alwatika mai gefuna biyu daidai ba ce” ba ya kayyade ∠A a matsayin ƙima guda ɗaya.
y-m-30-06.s.s2.prompt: Domin fadin ya zama daidai 15 cm², menene dole ∠A ya zama? Zaɓi duk masu yiwuwa.
y-m-30-06.s.s2.hint.0: Ga kowane ∠A da ake tunani a kai, ƙididdige ½×6×10×sin A ka kwatanta da 15.
y-m-30-06.s.s2.hint.1: Da farko warware ma’aunin fadi ½×6×10×sin A = 15 a matsayin ma’aunin sin A, sannan nemo ƙimar sin A.
y-m-30-06.s.s2.r.a: Idan ba ka duba ƙimar sin ga kusurwa mai faɗi ba, wannan ƙima ce mai sauƙin mantawa.
y-m-30-06.s.s2.r.b: Idan ka ƙididdige fadi kai tsaye ga kusurwa ta dama, za ka iya duba ko ya zama 15.
y-m-30-06.s.s2.r.c: Wannan ƙima ce da ka tabbatar da fadi ta amfani da sin 30° = 1/2.
y-m-30-06.s.s2.r.d: Idan ka ƙididdige fadi da ƙimar sin 60°, za ka iya duba ko ya zama 15.
y-m-30-06.s.s2.explain: Fadi = ½×6×10×sin A = 30 sin A = 15 yana ba da sin A = 1/2. Tsakanin 0° da 180°, kusurwoyi biyu ne sin A=1/2: 30° da 150°. A 90° fadi 30 ne, a 60° kuma kusan 26.0 ne.
y-m-30-06.s.s3.prompt: Alwatikan biyun da aka yi da kusurwoyi biyu da ka samo a s2 suna da AB=6, AC=10, kuma fadinsu duka 15 cm² ne. Amma siffofinsu ba iri ɗaya ba ne. Bayyana aƙalla hanya ɗaya da alwatikan biyun suka bambanta.
y-m-30-06.s.s3.hint.0: Kwatanta wane gefe ne ya fi tsawo a kowace alwatika daga cikin biyun.
y-m-30-06.s.s3.hint.1: Ɗauki AC a matsayin tushe ka kwatanta tsayoyin da aka zana daga B a yanayin biyun.

y-m-30-06.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ka bambance dalilin da ya sa fadinsu iri ɗaya ne (tsayi iri ɗaya ne, sine iri ɗaya ne) da dalilin da ya sa siffofinsu suka bambanta?

y-m-30-06.s.s3.model.0: Idan ∠A=30°, kusurwar A mai kaifi ce, BC kusan 5.7 cm ne; amma idan 150° ne, kusurwar mai faɗi ce kuma BC kusan 15.5 cm ne, ya fi tsawo sosai. Ko da fadi iri ɗaya ne, 15, siffar ta bambanta.
y-m-30-06.s.s3.model.1: A duka biyun, idan aka ɗauki AC=10 a matsayin tushe, tsayin da aka zana daga B iri ɗaya ne, 3 cm, don haka fadinsu iri ɗaya ne. Amma a 150°, B yana wajen tsawaitawar AC, saboda haka siffar ta bambanta.

y-m-30-01.title: Shin alwatika mai gefuna 8, 15, 17 alwatika mai kusurwa ta dama ce?
y-m-30-01.topic: Maganganun juyawar ka’idar Pythagoras da alwatikan mai kusurwa ta dama waɗanda tsawon gefunansu lambobi ne na halitta
y-m-30-01.goal: Duba wane gefe aka ɗauka a matsayin mafi tsawo yayin tantance alwatika mai kusurwa ta dama. Nemo alwatikan masu kusurwa ta dama da gefunansu lambobi ne na halitta, iri daban-daban, sannan ka bayyana ma’anar “iri ɗaya”.
y-m-30-01.material: Minseo ta auna gefuna uku na kayan ado mai siffar alwatika, ta samu 8 cm, 15 cm, da 17 cm. Ba ta auna kusurwoyi ba, tsawon gefuna uku kaɗai ta sani. Don tantance ko alwatikan mai kusurwa ta dama ne, Minseo ta yi lissafi kamar haka. (Dukkan tsawo cm ne. Ana karanta 8² “takwas murabba’i”, 17² kuma “goma sha bakwai murabba’i”.)

y-m-30-01.prereq.1: A cikin alwatika mai kusurwa ta dama, dangantakar jimillar murabba’in gefuna biyu da murabba’in sauran gefe, da kuma gaskiyar cewa akasin ka’idar ma tana aiki (matakin aji na 9 na sakandare)
y-m-30-01.prereq.2: Masu rabon lamba da babban mai rabon gama-gari
y-m-30-01.s.s1.prompt: Zaɓi layi ɗaya da bai daidai ba a lissafin Minseo. Ƙirga lambobin layi daga 1.
y-m-30-01.s.s1.hint.0: Yi irin wannan lissafi da alwatika mai kusurwa ta dama da aka sani, 3, 4, 5. Idan ka ɗauki 3 da 5 a matsayin gefuna da suka samar da kusurwar dama, ka kwatanta 3²+5² da 4², me ke faruwa?
y-m-30-01.s.s1.hint.1: Bayan ka duba inda mafi tsawon gefe yake a alwatika 3, 4, 5, kwatanta ko gefuna biyun da Minseo ta zaɓa suna matsayi iri ɗaya.
y-m-30-01.s.s1.line.1: Ban san wane gefe ne hypotenuse ba, bari in ɗauki 8 da 17 a matsayin gefuna biyu da suka samar da kusurwar dama, in yi lissafi.
y-m-30-01.s.s1.line.3: 353 ≠ 225, saboda haka wannan alwatika ba mai kusurwa ta dama ba ce.
y-m-30-01.s.s1.explain: Layi na 2 ne matsalar. Idan alwatika mai kusurwa ta dama ne, gefen da yake gaban kusurwar dama (hypotenuse) shi ne mafi tsawo. Saboda haka dole ne a kwatanta mafi tsawon gefe 17 da “jimillar murabba’in sauran gefuna biyu”. Idan aka ɗauki 17 a matsayin gefe da ya samar da kusurwar dama, wannan ba zai iya zama gaskiya ga kowane alwatika ba. Don haka ƙarshen layi na 4 ma ba abin dogaro ba ne. Lissafin daidai shi ne 8²+15²=64+225=289=17², saboda haka alwatika mai kusurwa ta dama ce.
y-m-30-01.s.s2.prompt: Ƙirƙiri alwatikan mai kusurwa ta dama guda 3 masu iri mabambanta waɗanda gefuna a, b, c dukkansu lambobi ne na halitta (c shi ne hypotenuse). y-m-30-03.title: Ƙimar nisa daga wuri a waje da da'irar zuwa maƙasudin tanganency
y-m-30-03.topic: Dangantaka tsakanin tangent na da'ira da radius
y-m-30-03.goal: Ku bi hanyar da tsawon tangent, wanda da farko za a iya ba da shi kawai a matsayin kewayon, za a ƙayyade lokacin da aka ƙara bayanin cewa tangent ɗin yana daidai da radius, kuma a yi hukunci ko wannan dalili ya shafi tangent na biyu.
y-m-30-03.material: Akwai da'irar O mai radius 5 cm. Daga maki P a waje da da'irar, zana tangent zuwa da'irar, kuma kira ma'anar tangency A. Nisa daga tsakiyar O zuwa batu P shine 13 cm. Kuna son nemo tsawon tangent PA. (Babu adadi. Hoton triangle mai maki uku O, A, P a matsayin madaidaitan sa.)
y-m-30-03.thinking.0: Ganin yadda kewayo da amincewar hukunci ke canzawa yayin da bayanai ke girma
y-m-30-03.thinking.1: Faɗar ƙididdige ƙididdigewa (13 - 5) ban da lissafi mai tushe
y-m-30-03.thinking.2: Yin hukunci ko yana da kyau a mika zuwa wani shari'ar mai tsari iri ɗaya
y-m-30-03.prereq.0: Dangantakar da ke tsakanin jimlar tsayin bangarorin biyu na alwatika da tsawon sauran bangaren

y-m-30-03.prereq.2: Dangantaka tsakanin ɓangarori uku na triangle dama
y-m-30-03.s.s1.prompt: Ana bayyana bayanai guda ɗaya a lokaci ɗaya. Yi hukunci ta amfani da bayanin kawai har zuwa wancan matakin, kuma zaku iya sake duba hukuncin bayan ganin bayani na gaba.
y-m-30-03.s.s1.hint.0: A kowane mataki, fara rubuta a cikin jumla ɗaya 'abin da aka saukar', sannan zaɓi.
y-m-30-03.s.s1.hint.1: Kwatanta cikin kalmomi irin dangantakar da ke tsakanin tsayin gefen uku na triangle da maki uku O, A da P suka yi.
y-m-30-03.s.s1.st.0.info: Abin da kuka sani yanzu: OA = 5 cm (radius), OP = 13 cm. Point A maki ne akan da'irar kuma PA shine tangent na wannan da'irar. Kada ku yi amfani da dukiyar tangents tukuna.
y-m-30-03.s.s1.st.0.ask: Me zaku iya cewa game da tsawon PA?
y-m-30-03.s.s1.st.0.after: Idan O, A, P basa kan layi daya, an kafa OAP triangle. A cikin triangle, jimlar bangarorin biyu ya fi sauran gefen, don haka PA ya fi 13 - 5 = 8 kuma ƙasa da 13 + 5 = 18. 8 shine mafi ƙarancin nisa daga aya P zuwa da'irar, kuma ba shine tsawon tangent ba. A yanzu za ku iya bayyana kewayon kawai.
y-m-30-03.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Wataƙila kun haɗu da mafi ƙarancin tazara daga aya P zuwa da'irar tare da tsawon tangent. Yi tunanin ko batu A shine matsayin da ke yin wannan nisa.
y-m-30-03.s.s1.st.0.o.b: Ya fi tsayi fiye da 8 cm kuma ya fi guntu fiye da 18 cm
y-m-30-03.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Wannan hukunci ne wanda ya samo iyakar tsayin daga gaskiyar cewa maki uku suna yin triangle.

y-m-30-03.s.s1.st.0.r.d: Wannan hukunci ne mai kyau wanda yayi la'akari da cewa ba a ƙayyade ainihin ƙimar ba tukuna.
y-m-30-03.s.s1.st.1.info: Sabbin bayanai: tangent yana tsaye zuwa radius ta wurin maɗaukakiyar tangency. Wato, OA ⊥ PA (bangarori biyu suna yin kusurwar dama).
y-m-30-03.s.s1.st.1.ask: Yin la'akari da wannan bayanin, me za ku iya cewa game da PA?
y-m-30-03.s.s1.st.1.after: Triangle OAP shine madaidaicin alwatika mai dama tare da kusurwar dama a A kuma hypotenuse shine OP. Don haka PA² = 13² - 5² = 144, da PA = 12 cm. 12 ya ta'allaka ne tsakanin 8 da 18, don haka hukuncin farko na kewayon bai yi kuskure ba, kuma sabon bayanin ya taƙaita kewayon zuwa ƙima ɗaya.
y-m-30-03.s.s1.st.1.o.a: Hukunci na farko kamar yadda yake: tsayi fiye da 8 cm kuma ya fi guntu fiye da 18 cm
y-m-30-03.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Hukuncin kewayon har yanzu gaskiya ne. Amma yi tunani game da ko za a iya ƙara ƙarawa tare da sabon bayanin.
y-m-30-03.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Wataƙila kun ƙara murabba'ai biyu ba tare da bincika ko OP wani gefe ne da ke samar da kusurwar dama ko hypotenuse ba.
y-m-30-03.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Wataƙila kun ajiye 8 ba tare da yin amfani da bayanin cewa tangent ɗin yana tsaye da radius ba.
y-m-30-03.s.s1.st.1.r.d: Wannan ita ce ƙimar da ta yi amfani da ma'anar cewa hypotenuse a cikin madaidaicin triangle OAP shine OP.

Gaskiyar cewa ma'anar tangency ta bambanta ya canza, amma yanayin da ke ƙayyade tsawon (radius 5, nisa zuwa tsakiyar 13, kusurwar dama) iri ɗaya ne, don haka darajar daidai take.

y-m-30-03.s.s2.hint.1: Rubuta tsarin gano PA ta amfani da kaddarorin tangents da siffar triangle OAP.
y-m-30-03.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Shin kun faɗi abin da ƙimar 8 ke wakilta (mafi ƙarancin nisa daga P zuwa da'irar)?
y-m-30-03.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Shin kun bayyana siffar triangle wanda ke ƙayyade tsawon tangent?
y-m-30-03.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Shin kun nuna tsarin da lambar da na zaɓa ta zama ainihin 12?
y-m-30-03.s.s2.model.0: 13-5=8 ita ce tazara mafi kusa daga aya P zuwa da'irar. Tangent PA yana daidai da radius OA, don haka triangle OAP triangle daidai ne kuma hypotenuse shine OP = 13, don haka PA = 12 cm.
y-m-30-03.s.s2.model.1: PA dole ne ya fi tsayi fiye da 8. A cikin triangle OAP, ƙara 5 da 8 yana ba da 13, don haka triangle ba a kafa ba. A cikin madaidaicin alwatika, 13 shine gefen mafi tsayi, don haka ya zama 12.

y-m-30-07.title: Shin an kayyade tazara tsakanin igiyoyin da’ira biyu masu layi ɗaya a matsayin ƙima guda ɗaya?
y-m-30-07.topic: Igiya a da’ira da tazara zuwa cibiyarta
y-m-30-07.goal: Nemo tazara daga cibiyar zuwa igiya, sannan ka yanke hukunci ka rubuta cewa amsar cikakkiya ce ne kawai idan ka yi la’akari da yanayin da igiyoyin da’ira biyu masu layi ɗaya suke gefe ɗaya da cibiyar da kuma yanayin da suke ɓangarori dabam-dabam.
y-m-30-07.material: A cikin da’ira O mai radius 13 cm, akwai igiyar AB mai tsawon 24 cm da igiyar CD mai tsawon 10 cm. Igiyoyin biyu suna layi ɗaya da juna. Ba a bayar da hoto ba. Kana son nemo tazara tsakanin igiyoyin. (Layin tsaye daga cibiyar da’ira zuwa igiya yana raba igiyar gida biyu daidai.)
y-m-30-07.thinking.1: Nemo zato da aka yi a ɓoye a cikin warwarewa
y-m-30-07.thinking.2: Rubuta amsa da ta danganta da sharuɗɗa (raba zuwa yanayi)
y-m-30-07.prereq.0: Gaskiyar cewa layin tsaye da aka zana daga cibiyar da’ira zuwa igiya yana raba igiyar gida biyu daidai.
y-m-30-07.s.s1.prompt: Nawa ne tazarar kowace igiya daga cibiyar da’ira O?
y-m-30-07.s.s1.hint.0: Bayyana da kalmomi alwatikan da kololuwoyinsa su ne ƙafar layin tsaye, ƙarshen igiya ɗaya, da cibiyar O, sannan nemo inda kusurwar dama take.
y-m-30-07.s.s1.hint.1: Bayan ka yanke shawarar gefen da ya fi tsawo a wannan alwatika, rubuta furucin da yake nemo sauran gefen daga tsawon biyun da aka sani.
y-m-30-07.s.s1.o.a: AB yana da tazarar 12 cm, CD kuma 5 cm.
y-m-30-07.s.s1.r.a: Wataƙila ka yi tunanin cewa yayin da igiya take tsawo, tana ƙara nisa da cibiyar. Yi alwatika mai kusurwa ta dama da rabin igiya da radius don dubawa.
y-m-30-07.s.s1.o.b: AB yana da tazarar 1 cm, CD kuma 8 cm.
y-m-30-07.s.s1.r.b: Wataƙila ka samo ta ne ta hanyar cire rabin tsawon igiya daga radius kai tsaye. Duba wane gefe ne hypotenuse.
y-m-30-07.s.s1.o.c: AB yana da tazarar 5 cm, CD kuma 12 cm.
y-m-30-07.s.s1.r.c: Wannan ƙima ta yi amfani da gaskiyar cewa layin tsaye daga cibiyar zuwa igiya yana ratsa tsakiyar igiyar.
y-m-30-07.s.s1.o.d: AB yana da tazarar √313 cm, CD kuma √194 cm.
y-m-30-07.s.s1.r.d: Wataƙila ka tara murabba’in rabin tsawon igiya da murabba’in radius. Duba wane gefe ne hypotenuse.
y-m-30-07.s.s1.explain: Ƙafar layin tsaye daga O zuwa AB ita ce tsakiyar AB. A alwatika mai kusurwa ta dama da rabin tsawon 12 da radius 13, tazara ita ce √(13² − 12²) = 5. Ga CD, rabin tsawon 5 ne, don haka √(13² − 5²) = 12. Igiyar da ta fi tsawo tana kusa da cibiyar.
y-m-30-07.s.s2.prompt: Ga warwarewar da ta nemo tazara tsakanin igiyoyin biyu. Zaɓi layin da aka yi zato ba tare da dalili ba. Ƙirga lambobin layi daga 1.
y-m-30-07.s.s2.hint.0: Sanya ɗaya daga waɗannan a gaban kowane layi: “an rubuta a tambaya / an samo ta daga lissafi / mai warwarewa ne ya yanke shawarar haka”.
y-m-30-07.s.s2.hint.1: Idan akwai layin da mai warwarewa ya yanke shawara a kansa, gwada yadda sakamakon zai canza idan aka yanke shawara dabam.
y-m-30-07.s.s2.line.0: Tazarar daga cibiyar O zuwa AB ita ce 5 cm, zuwa CD kuma 12 cm.
y-m-30-07.s.s2.line.1: Igiyoyin biyu suna layi ɗaya, saboda haka layukan tsaye daga O zuwa igiyoyin biyu suna kan layi guda.
y-m-30-07.s.s2.line.2: Igiyoyin biyu suna gefe ɗaya da O.
y-m-30-07.s.s2.line.3: Saboda haka tazara tsakanin igiyoyin biyu ita ce 12 − 5 = 7 cm.
y-m-30-07.s.s2.line.4: Saboda haka amsar ita ce 7 cm kawai.
y-m-30-07.s.s2.explain: Layi na 3 ne matsalar. Tambayar ba ta ce igiyoyin biyu suna gefe ɗaya da O ba, amma warwarewar ta ɗauka haka. Layi na 4 da 5 ƙarshen hukunci ne da ya biyo daga wannan zato, saboda haka layin da aka yi zato ba tare da tushe ba shi ne layi na 3. Layin 1 da 2 daidai ne.
y-m-30-07.s.s3.prompt: Zana yanayin da igiyoyin biyu suke ɓangarori dabam-dabam na cibiyar O. Nemo tazarar a wannan yanayin, sannan ka rubuta yadda ya kamata a bayar da amsar tambayar nan.
y-m-30-07.s.s3.hint.0: Canza zato a layi na 3 na warwarewar, ka zana igiyoyin biyu a ɓangarori dabam-dabam na O.
y-m-30-07.s.s3.hint.1: A wannan yanayin, bayyana da kalmomi yadda za a haɗa tazarorin 5 da 12 daga O zuwa igiyoyin biyu domin samun tazara tsakaninsu.
y-m-30-07.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ka faɗi yadda ka nemo tazara a yanayin ɓangarori dabam-dabam (yadda ka haɗa 5 da 12)?
y-m-30-07.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ka rubuta duka amsar gefen ɗaya (7 cm) da amsar ɓangarori dabam-dabam (17 cm)?
y-m-30-07.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Ka bayyana dalilin da ya sa ba za a iya kayyade matsayinsu ba idan babu hoto?
y-m-30-07.s.s3.model.0: Idan suna ɓangarori dabam-dabam, tazarar ita ce 5+12=17 cm. Saboda haka idan igiyoyin biyu suna gefe ɗaya da O tazarar 7 cm ce; idan suna ɓangarori dabam-dabam 17 cm ce. Tunda babu hoto, duka biyun, 7 cm ko 17 cm, amsoshi ne.
y-m-30-07.s.s3.model.1: Idan O yana tsakaninsu, a tara 5 da 12 don samun 17 cm. Idan suna gefe ɗaya, 7 cm ne. Tambayar ba ta fayyace matsayinsu ba, saboda haka zan rubuta cewa amsoshi biyu ne (7 cm, 17 cm).

y-m-30-08.title: Itace mafi tsawo da za ta shiga cikin akwati
y-m-30-08.topic: Diagonal na akwatin mai kusurwa huɗu (amfani da ka’idar Pythagoras a girma uku)
y-m-30-08.goal: Yayin nemo tsawon sashen layi a cikin abu mai girma uku, yi amfani da gaskiyar cewa diagonal na tushe da tsayi suna samar da kusurwar dama. Ƙirƙiri akwatuna da dama inda tsawon diagonal lamba ta halitta ce, sannan ka tantance ko itace za ta shiga.
y-m-30-08.material: Akwai akwatin mai kusurwa huɗu fanko, faɗinsa 3 cm, zurfinsa 4 cm, tsayinsa kuma 12 cm. Kana son saka siririyar itace da ba ta lankwasawa gaba ɗaya cikin akwatin. Yi watsi da kaurin akwatin, ka ɗauka ma’aunin ciki da na waje iri ɗaya ne. Kana son nemo tsawon itace mafi tsawo da za ta iya shiga cikin akwatin.
y-m-30-08.thinking.0: Nemo layin da ba daidai ba a warwarewa mai kuskure
y-m-30-08.thinking.1: Ƙirƙirar akwatuna da dama da suka cika ƙuntatawa
y-m-30-08.thinking.2: Tantancewa ta kwatanta sakamako da tsawon itace

y-m-30-08.s.s1.prompt: Di handap ieu solusi saurang murid nu néangan panjang iteuk pangpanjangna. Pilih hiji léngkah nu salah. Itung nomer léngkahna ti 1.
y-m-30-08.s.s1.hint.0: Jelaskeun ku kecap kumaha iteuk ngagolér serong ti hiji tungtung kotak ka pojok luhur sabalikna, tuluy tingali sudut nu dibentuk ku angka 5 jeung 12 dina léngkah 3.
y-m-30-08.s.s1.hint.1: Gambar segitiga nu kabentuk ku dua ruas panjangna 5 cm jeung 12 cm sarta iteuk. Pariksa maké hubungan sisi segitiga naha tilu panjang sisi 5, 12, 17 mungkin.
y-m-30-08.s.s1.line.1: Panjang diagonal alas nyaéta 3² + 4² = 25, jadi panjangna 5.
y-m-30-08.s.s1.line.2: Iteukna ngagolér dina wangun nu nyambungkeun diagonal alas 5 jeung jangkungna 12, jadi 5 + 12 = 17.
y-m-30-08.s.s1.explain: Léngkah 3 nu jadi masalah. Iteuk ngagolér serong ti hiji pojok alas ka pojok luhur sabalikna, jadi diagonal alas (5) jeung jangkungna (12) silih jejeg, sarta iteuk jadi hipotenusa segitiga siku-siku nu dua sisina 5 jeung 12. Hipotenusa lain jumlah dua sisi, tapi akar kuadrat tina jumlah kuadratna, jadi leuwih pondok. Ku kituna 17 cm dina léngkah 4 ogé salah. Itungan nu bener nyaéta √(5² + 12²) = 13 cm.
y-m-30-08.s.s2.prompt: Di antara kotak sagi opat nu rubak a, jero b, jeung jangkungna c masing-masing angka asli ti 1 nepi ka 12, jieun 3 kotak béda nu panjang iteuk pangpanjangna nu muat di jerona ogé angka asli. (Kotak nu a, b, c-na ngan béda urutan dianggap kotak nu sarua.)
y-m-30-08.s.s2.hint.0: Tetepkeun dua tina tilu ukuran, téangan kuadrat diagonal alas, tuluy robah jangkungna jeung pariksa naha jumlah total jadi kuadrat hiji angka.
y-m-30-08.s.s2.hint.1: Bandingkeun kotak nu kapanggih jeung ukuran awal 3, 4, 12, tuluy cobaan runtuy ti angka leutik ku cara nu sarua.
y-m-30-08.s.s2.ok.c1: Tilu ukuranana angka asli ti 1 nepi ka 12.
y-m-30-08.s.s2.fail.c1: Rubak, jero, jeung jangkungna kudu angka asli ti 1 nepi ka 12.
y-m-30-08.s.s2.ok.c2: Panjang iteuk pangpanjangna téh angka asli.
y-m-30-08.s.s2.fail.c2: Panjang iteuk pangpanjangna (akar kuadrat jumlah kuadrat tilu ukuran) lain angka asli.
y-m-30-08.s.s2.explain: Contona, (1, 2, 2) ngahasilkeun √9 = 3; (2, 3, 6) ngahasilkeun √49 = 7; (4, 4, 7) ngahasilkeun √81 = 9; jeung (2, 4, 4) ngahasilkeun √36 = 6. Kotak awal (3, 4, 12) ngahasilkeun √169 = 13, jadi kaasup kotak nu nyumponan sarat ieu.
y-m-30-08.s.s3.prompt: Anjeun nempatkeun iteuk dina kotak nu rubakna 3, jerona 4, jangkungna 12. Kumaha hubungan nu luyu antara panjang iteuk jeung kotak? (13 cm nyaéta panjang iteuk pangpanjangna.)
y-m-30-08.s.s3.hint.0: Kalawan iteuk 13 cm diteundeun sapanjang diagonal, jelaskeun ku kecap naon nu kajadian kana panjang iteuk lamun hiji tungtungna digésér saeutik ka jero.
y-m-30-08.s.s3.hint.1: Pikeun unggal pilihan, jieun tabel nu misahkeun kasus iteuk leuwih panjang ti 13, sarua jeung 13, atawa leuwih pondok ti 13.
y-m-30-08.s.s3.o.a: Iteuk 13.1 cm ogé bisa diasupkeun lamun diteundeun serong.
y-m-30-08.s.s3.r.a: Pikirkeun naha iteuk nu leuwih panjang tibatan iteuk pangpanjangna bisa diasupkeun.
y-m-30-08.s.s3.o.b: Sakabéh iteuk nu leuwih panjang ti 12 cm teu bisa diasupkeun.
y-m-30-08.s.s3.r.b: Anjeun bisa waé nganggap 12 minangka wates lantaran éta sisi pangpanjangna. Pikirkeun naha ruas serong bisa leuwih panjang tibatan hiji sisi.
y-m-30-08.s.s3.o.c: Sakabéh iteuk nu panjangna 13 cm atawa kurang bisa diasupkeun, ari 13.1 cm teu bisa.
y-m-30-08.s.s3.r.c: Ieu kacindekan nu sakaligus mertimbangkeun panjang ruas pangpanjangna jeung naha iteuk nu leuwih pondok bisa diasupkeun.
y-m-30-08.s.s3.o.d: Ngan iteuk 13 cm nu bisa diasupkeun, ari 12.8 cm teu bisa.
y-m-30-08.s.s3.r.d: Anjeun bisa waé nganggap iteuk nu leuwih pondok teu bisa diasupkeun. Pikirkeun naon nu kajadian lamun hiji tungtungna digésér.
y-m-30-08.s.s3.explain: Ruas pangpanjangna nu bisa ditempatkeun dina kotak nyaéta diagonal, panjangna 13 cm. Jadi unggal iteuk nu panjangna 13 cm atawa kurang bisa diasupkeun, ari iteuk 13.1 cm teu bisa. Iteuk leuwih panjang ti 12 cm ogé bisa diasupkeun lamun diteundeun serong.
